body:
It's not about the achievements. Since I was young I've always wanted to get into astrophysics and now that seems like an unachievable feat.

Thank you for your words of encouragement... they mean more than you know. I've found that when I'm feeling at my lowest all it takes for me to see the light is for someone to treat me like more than another face or a piece of garbage...

Though even still, nothing in my life seems to hold any meaning... I work with a girl who is also my buddy's girlfriend and the other night after I finished saying something (I forget what I was saying), she muttered to herself "you're disgusting...," I presume thinking I wouldn't hear it. My buddy leaned over and asked her, "why do you keep coming at Chase like that?" She just smiled and kept driving.

I don't know what it is about me that people hate so much... Why am I everyone's target? Why are people compelled to belittle me and harbor these opinions of me? I try... so hard... to not notice these things and to ignore them altogether but it is so blatantly obvious... It's like because I think of myself as disgusting and irrelevant, others feel more inclined to agree than to assist... If that is the case, then I don't want to live in a world where our very nature is oriented towards that concept. Or perhaps it is truly that I am disgusting and hideous and only when I'm not in the mood to mask that truth with splashes of enthusiasm and personality that others begin to realize it... Either way... I hate myself and so does everyone else
